Wiedźmin 3 - (prawie)Najlepsza gra w jaką w życiu zagrałem

Uno dei migliori ARPG che ho mai giocato pieno di contenuto tra missioni secondarie, tutte con una storia interessante e per niente ripetitive (come ti aspetteresti da un open world qualunque), una grande quantità di creature da affrontare (anche se ho notato troppo spesso reskin). La componente RPG è più presente di quello che pensassi, attraverso decotti, pozioni, abilità, rune e mutageni (aggiunti nell'espansione Blood and Wine) si possono creare svariate build per Geralt aumentando la replayability del gioco. La storia principale mi è piaciuta molto, anche se avrei preferito avere più scelte di dialogo che influenzano effettivamente il corso della storia e quindi magari più finali. 

Note negative:
-Certi boss hanno troppa vita soprattutto nell'espansione Hearts of Stone rendendo sfiancante e ripetitivo il combattimento (anche perché molte di esse sono abbastanza facili)
-La mappa di Skellige a mio parere è costruita davvero male, è molto difficile muoversi per via di montagne impossibili da scalare in modo intuitivo e crepacci, il mare è intasato da punti interrogativi tutti uguali che se vuoi completare al 100% il gioco ti annoierano quasi sicuramente
Very fun, great story + graphics + gameplay

Does one need to comment on this one?

An absolute gem among RPG games. An absolute treasure in history of single players games with deep lore and amazing music.

The game has incredibly fascinating world, funny and witty dialogue lines. There is an interesting story, there is a whole bunch of side quests along the main story line.

The game has big expansions which add additional regions and basically make it 2-3 times bigger compared to the base game.

I didn't play Witcher 1. It was a pretty mediocre stiff game. Witcher 2 was much better and quite enjoyable.

Boy, Witcher 3 is the pinnacle of Witcher series and one of the best RPG games EVER.

It easily overcomes games like Divinity, Dungeon Siege, but honestly it's not even a typical RPG game.
There is not an isometric view, there is the third person camera. It's more of a first person game, but it's a DnD type of game stripped off of companions.

You're the main character, you have just one class, you have just one alignment.
The thing is, everything else is perfect and super interesting.

The story is the main aspect of this game. It's one of the kind. You could try comparing this game to KoTOR series, but this game is much more.

I liked the appearance of this game and playing this game. I did not like the choices, information, and  options in this game. It confused me and stressed me. It's likely that I may not play this game again.

The witcher 3 is able to create a really impressive atmosphere thanks to its stellar visual design and music, and the story has some good moments, despite often being quite cheesy and immature. 
Speaking of gameplay, it's a really unremarkable game that seems to capitalize on every trend from its era, like the open world map, crafting mechanics, "rpg" elements, etc.

All in all though, it definitely has more positives than negatives and I can't not recommend it, especially seeing how it often goes on sale for really cheap.
